{"design":"DESIGN 2026-11-17 (Mark: "run it out"; INVENTED surfaces marked as such in code)

Wire (mimi-content-10 §4.5, Figure "ExternalPart"): attachments are ExternalParts in a
MultiPart processAll [text part, external parts...]. encAlg 1 = AES-128-GCM (MTI), random
16-octet key, 12-octet nonce, empty aad; hashAlg 1 = sha-256 over the stored bytes
(the ciphertext). size = octets stored at the URL (ciphertext) -- reading; the draft does not say
whether size is plaintext or stored; WG feedback held per Mark.

Server (mimid-server), stage 1:
- Blob store (sqlite): per account, random 128-bit blobId (base64url), bytes, type. Cap
  MAX_BLOB_LEN (INVENTED, 16 MiB) and a per-account count/bytes quota (INVENTED).
- POST /jmap/upload/{accountId}/ (RFC 8620 §6.1) and GET /jmap/download/{accountId}/{blobId}/{name}
  (§6.2), owner only. Session maxSizeUpload = MAX_BLOB_LEN.
- GET /assets/{blobId}: unauthenticated, the asset server. The id is the capability; content is
  ciphertext. application/octet-stream, nosniff, no CORS. Session mimi capability gets
  "assetUrl": "{base}/assets/{blobId}" (INVENTED).
- GET /jmap/asset/{accountId}?room=<roomUri>&url=<downloadUrl> (INVENTED): a user's fetch of an
  attachment. Own asset URL -> local blob. Otherwise the room's hub: self -> hub::assets
  check+fetch; peer -> signed GET {hub}/v1/proxyDownload/{downloadUrl} (protocol-07 §5.10.2).
  The user must be a participant of the room the server knows (or at least the room must be
  one this provider serves). Bounded by MAX_ASSET_LEN.

Agent (mimid-agent-core, -jmap, daemon), stage 2:
- core: seal/open (AES-128-GCM, sha-256 check before decrypt), Agent::upload_asset -> ExternalPart,
  Agent::fetch_asset(room, &ExternalPart) -> plaintext; send_content with MultiPart.
- jmap: blob store on disk under state_dir/blobs (0600), upload/download routes on the daemon,
  ChatBackend::attachment_blob; Message/set attachments -> ExternalParts; received ExternalParts
  -> fetched, decrypted, stored, Message.attachments. AgentChat::limits reports attachments."}
